title: Fix Dimensional Sync
description: Backport the fix of some bugs to older versions.
body:
This mod backports the fix of some bugs to older versions, which cause some sync issues when teleporting between dimensions.

**Fix List**

[MC-6431](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-6431): Status effects are lost when returning to the overworld from the exit end portal

[MC-124177](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-124177): Teleporting to another dimension loses some client states

**Current support:**

Minecraft version: **1.18.X,1.19.X,1.20.X**

Mod loader: **Fabric**

**Future plans:**

Support for more Minecraft versions is planned and will be released in the next few months.

Stay tuned for updates, and feel free to report any issues on our GitHub page.
